domain.text: vmethod gateway worktree cleanup and pruning for merged or closed task worktrees

impressions.text: The model delivered journaled, idempotent worktree cleanup, guarded pruning, and extensive regression coverage; the worker reported all required checks passing.
Review caught a live-smoke failure where one `du` error aborted the listing; the orchestrator requested best-effort sizing and a regression test.
The worker addressed the catch by bounding each size scan, continuing on failures, and testing listing and pruning with failed measurements.
The orchestrator’s follow-up live listing reported four removable trees and safely skipped a tree with no recorded session; the PR was merged.
